draft issues, PR scopes, checklists, and delivery reports
request authoritative evidence from existing governed tools
resume from stable checkpoints without replaying verified work

declare completion from narrative without exact authoritative evidence

Resolve authenticated or bounded intake identity before scope
Resolve tenant workspace Brand account and resources from canonical authority
Create durable idempotent intake identity and receipt
Create immutable evidence identity and preserve provenance metadata
Keep synchronous intake independent from model completion
Return or resume the prior receipt for duplicate intake delivery
Separate verbatim observation interpretation hypothesis and recommendation
Support one canonical evidence object with multiple usage links
Preserve canonical original before derivative operations
Generate sanitized names without model overwrite authority
Create deterministic content fingerprints and normalized source URLs
Detect exact duplicates and create semantic candidates only
Require human decision before duplicate deletion or canonical merge
Use explicit quarantine restricted unsorted and review states
Audit and read back file movement rename shortcut and access operations

Declare modality sensitivity consent budget model and fallback per use case
Validate structured provider output against pinned JSON Schema
Reject semantically invalid or policy-conflicting model output
Treat function calls as proposals requiring governed execution
Keep AI output proposed until deterministic or human authorization
Use bounded retry and readback for transient or unknown outcomes
Preserve manual processing when the provider is disabled
Authorize and audit every human review action at object scope
Support complete review decision taxonomy and transitions
Prohibit AI approval deletion grants publishing and sensitive routing
Use typed downstream links while preserving source lineage
Keep client statements distinct from independently verified facts
Bind clarification requests and replies to original context
Version and rollback prompts schemas models policies and routes
Resolve every active model alias from certified registry evidence
Expose bounded lifecycle reasons traces and evidence references
Measure cost latency failures safety retries overrides duplicates and utilization
Enforce scoped daily and monthly budget thresholds
Apply retention and deletion rules by artifact type and hold state
Deny restricted data provider processing by default
Exclude secrets credentials signed URLs and raw payloads from evidence
Classify all persistent entities into existing domains and Work Maps
Support disabled shadow pilot canary production and rollback states
Require exact-head and production evidence for governed closeout

acceptance_criteria.statement: The contract and all structured schemas validate with no unresolved references
Every task has immutable scope dependencies owner tests gates evidence and resume key
Planning produces deterministic ready or blocked work packets without mutation authority
Duplicate intake delivery creates no duplicate operation and returns the prior receipt
Original evidence remains preserved and duplicate candidates are never auto-deleted
Wrong tenant Brand account or resource is denied before storage or provider access
Model output cannot approve delete grant publish or mutate protected resources
Schema-invalid or semantic-invalid model output cannot reach downstream state
Provider failure does not lose accepted intake and manual review remains available
Unknown outcome is read back before retry and recovered success is not replayed
Restricted data and secrets are excluded from provider requests logs and evidence
Every AI result preserves model prompt schema policy and input-manifest lineage
A representative intake reaches review and closure with Gemini disabled
Human decisions and overrides are authorized attributable versioned and linked
Cost latency retry safety and utilization metrics are available by use case and scope
Arabic and mixed-language golden data meets approved quality thresholds
Rollback disables AI dispatch while preserving intake evidence and manual processing
Closeout fails when tasks checks CI contracts migration deployment or runtime evidence is incomplete
